title: A new directory under .dd needs four places updated
trigger: when adding a new directory or file kind under .dd/ that the store writes (like legacy/ or actions/)
behavior_delta: Register a new .dd/ directory in four places at once. Update the journal path whitelist in operationPath (src/store/transactions.js), the directories readStored or its listing reads (src/store/git-file-store.js), sourceFingerprint (src/store/fingerprint.js) if the files are indexed, and the watcher regex in src/store/create-store.js. Missing the whitelist fails every write with invalid_journal_path; missing the fingerprint or watcher leaves the index or the live UI stale without any error.
what: Register a new .dd/ directory in four places at once. Update the journal path whitelist in operationPath (src/store/transactions.js), the directories readStored or its listing reads (src/store/git-file-store.js), sourceFingerprint (src/store/fingerprint.js) if the files are indexed, and the watcher regex in src/store/create-store.js. Missing the whitelist fails every write with invalid_journal_path; missing the fingerprint or watcher leaves the index or the live UI stale without any error.
why: Adding legacy/ and actions/ on 2026-09-24, the plan listed paths, git store and fingerprint but not the journal whitelist; the first write failed with invalid_journal_path. The watcher and fingerprint gaps fail silently.
trigger_variants: Add a new kind of file under .dd
Agregar un tipo de archivo nuevo dentro de .dd

evidence_refs.summary: operationPath only accepts journal paths under an explicit list of directories.
The .dd watcher regex names the directories whose changes refresh the index and notify the UI.
sourceFingerprint walks a fixed list of directories to decide when to reindex.
